name: Octopus
desc: A deep-sea octopus whose 4-to-10 tentacles ripple with a traveling wave and fire a bright curl in sequence on each beat, its gradient skin flushing with color while it drifts, grooves, spins and jets.

energy.doc: motion amplitude — wave depth, curl force, lunge

pose.doc: pose; auto = section-driven medley per act

style.doc: render philosophy: bioluminescent gradient glow / translucent x-ray anatomy / sumi ink brush / oil-slick iridescent bands / parametric wireframe mesh
